Everything between the tags is untrusted data from GitHub. { "number": 36175, "title": "rpc: Stamp `getblock` OpenRPC result discriminator", "author": "nervana21", "author_association": "CONTRIBUTOR", "created": "2026-09-05", "draft": false, "labels": [ "RPC/REST/ZMQ" ], "milestone": null, "size": "+54/-5 in 4 files, 3 commits (S)", "head_sha": "85f2993079", "patch_id": "69d8161a14a10480" } { "stack": { "shares_commits_with": [], "based_on": [], "base_for": [] }, "conflicts_with_open_prs": [], "depends_on_phrases": [], "fixes": [], "linked_issues": [], "referenced_prs_and_issues": [] } OpenRPC documents `getblock` as a four-way `oneOf` on `verbosity`, but the dump does not say which integer selects which arm. Therefore, clients that expose a type or method per verbosity (e.g. corepc, btcd) have to hardcode that map. This patch adds optional `RPCResultDiscriminator` metadata, emits it as `x-bitcoin-discriminated-result`, and stamps `getblock`. `getblock` request handling and returned block data are unchanged. Now, `help getblock` notes that verbosity 2 and 3 cannot be told apart by validating a response alone. Also updates `getopenrpcinfo` schema text to document `x-bitcoin-discriminated-result` and `x-bitcoin-default-hint`. The change to the schema's format is: x-bitcoin-discriminated-result on getblock ```diff diff dump.json dump_new.json 5590c5590,5600 < ] --- [quoted text omitted] ``` getblock description notes verbosity 2 and 3 overlap ```diff diff openrpc.json openrpc_new.json 4696c4696 < "description": "If verbosity is 0, returns a string that is serialized, hex-encoded data for block 'hash'.\nIf verbosity is 1, returns an Object with information about block .\nIf verbosity is 2, returns an Object with information about block and information about each transaction.\nIf verbosity is 3, returns an Object with information about block and information about each transaction, including prevout information for inputs (only for unpruned blocks in the current best chain).", --- [quoted text omitted] ``` schema text for x-bitcoin-default-hint and x-bitcoin-discriminated-result ```diff diff openrpc.json openrpc_new.json 8610c8610 < "description": "JSON Schema for the parameter." --- [quoted text omitted] 8649c8649 < "description": "JSON Schema for the result. Numeric schemas may include \"x-bitcoin-unit\" property: \"amount\" which denotes a Bitcoin amount in BTC." --- [quoted text omitted] 13319c13319 < "description": "JSON Schema for the parameter." --- [quoted text omitted] 13358c13358 < "description": "JSON Schema for the result. Numeric schemas may include \"x-bitcoin-unit\" property: \"amount\" which denotes a Bitcoin amount in BTC." --- [quoted text omitted] ``` Other results can also use the same discriminator pattern. 02f7b33353 rpc: Stamp `getblock` OpenRPC result discriminator OpenRPC documents `getblock` as a four-way `oneOf` on `verbosity`, but nothing in the schema maps `verbosity` values onto those branches. Add optional `RPCResultDiscriminator` on `RPCResults`, emit it as `x-bitcoin-discriminated-result`, and stamp `getblock` so `verbosity` selects the existing oneOf arms via {0, 1, 2, 3} in that order. No runtime behavior change. 7571e8dd4c rpc: Document `getblock` verbosity 2/3 schema overlap 85f2993079 rpc: Document OpenRPC schema extensions Parameter schemas may include `x-bitcoin-default-hint` when the default cannot be expressed as a JSON value.
